official_price_rule: Strict fresh is preferred. Deep analysis may also use scanlite.deep_usable=true when the core liquid market is recent; final candidate prices are always rechecked. day_change_pct is previous-close based, not true rolling24h.

scanlite.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps. V2.7.2c exposes actionable/stale watch arrays separately and deep_usable separately.

final_price_recheck_top15.rule: selected candidates must be rechecked after deep analysis; abs(scan_to_final_pct)>=1% => price_move_warning
